reviews.summary: HOT is in a live, newly launched HOT→HoloFuel migration event. Conversion is irreversible, HoloFuel has no established liquidity, and the operator’s licence is provisional—creating material event and regulatory uncertainty around HOT now.
materialRisks: The HOT-to-HoloFuel bridge/swap went live on November 1, 2026. A completed swap is irreversible; converted HoloFuel has no established market or assured external liquidity. ([holo.host](https://holo.host//blog/?utm_source=openai))

The swap/bridge operator is licensed provisionally for 90 days from November 1, 2026; renewal, amendment, suspension, or revocation could halt further swap/bridge operations. ([netzero.zone](https://netzero.zone/platform-terms.html?utm_source=openai))

Holo officially reports an active surge in impersonation and counterfeit-swap scams associated with the launch, increasing operational/custody risk for HOT holders who engage with migration-related links or software. ([holo.host](https://holo.host/resources/safety-reminders-holofuel-launch-hot-swap/?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Asset identity is Holo (HOT), the Ethereum ERC-20 at 0x6c6EE5e31d828De241282B9606C8e98Ea48526E2. ([netzero.zone](https://netzero.zone/platform-terms.html?utm_source=openai))

Bridging HOT locks—not burns—the ERC-20 tokens; however, swapping mirrored HOT to HoloFuel cannot be reversed except for limited earned-HoloFuel provisions. ([netzero.zone](https://netzero.zone/platform-terms.html?utm_source=openai))

The HOT-to-HoloFuel swap window is stated to remain open for at least six months from November 1, 2026, so there is no stated immediate migration deadline. ([netzero.zone](https://netzero.zone/platform-terms.html?utm_source=openai))
No current spot-delisting or HOT-EUR venue-maintenance notice was confirmed in the reviewed primary sources.
